newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for April 8.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for April 8.

text.p: All Mexican ports were open Tuesday, Communications and Transport Ministry (SCT) said in its 1000 local/1500 GMT daily meteorological report.

A weak cold front moving south from the Texas coast continuing to bring strong winds and rains to northwestern Gulf of Mexico. The ministry advised all ships of poor weather in the region. The ministry updated port conditions and
shipping warnings for the Pacific Coast, Gulf of Mexico and Caribbean.
Light isolated rains and lower temperatures on northern coastline with maximum winds from 10 to 15 knots (19 to 28 km/11 to 16 miles per hour) and waves three to six feet high.

Cold front bringing strong wind gusts and rains to Tamaulipas, Veracruz and Tanasco coasts. Winds in the northwest gulf from the southeast at 15 to 20 knots (28 to 38 km/16 to 22 miles per hour) and waves six to nine feet high.
Remainder of gulf experiencing winds of 10 to 15 knots and waves four to six feet high.
Hot and partly cloudy with moderate winds from 20 to 30 km per hour.
